sourceLaw: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.

lum.responsibility: Single task intake, route approved responsibilities, reconcile evidence, present Professor decision

yume.responsibility: Art direction, character identity, animation/editorial composition and candidate manifest

urdDoctorGoddess.responsibility: Investigate failed asset checks, contamination and evidence drift

belldandySecretary.responsibility: Naming, source/derivative hash ledger, creator credit, license and approval receipt continuity

skuldResearch.responsibility: Blender/GLB Godot4 FFmpeg import compatibility, performance target and dependency license review

creativeProfile.primary: one foreground rigged high-detail 3D character per scene by default
creativeProfile.secondary: 2D sprites, static illustrations, background plates or pre-rendered video
creativeProfile.masters: Original editable source kept private and backed up with creator identity and rights
creativeProfile.runtimeDerivative: GLB with application-specific material, mesh and texture budgets, not universal polygon limits
creativeProfile.mobile: Performance is UNKNOWN until same-device test
creativeProfile.clip: FFmpeg concept/render is not model output or live agent output

costPolicy: Existing GitHub and Render, local tools first; no paid inference without explicit approval
